operation.add:
$helptxt['descriptive_links_title_url'] = 'Enable this option to automatically update links, displaying their corresponding page titles. This addon can also convert internal topic, page, and board links to show the topic or message subject.
When a user posts a URL outside a [url] [/url] tag (or even inside one), the addon detects it, retrieves the webpage title, and replaces the link with a properly formatted BBC URL, using the found title.
For example: https://www.mysitehere.com
will be transformed into:
[url=https://www.mysitehere.com]My Website Title[/url]
If the page title cannot be retrieved, the URL remains unchanged.
This transformation occurs when the post is created or edited—rather than dynamically—to prevent potential delays in page loading.';
